grades.quote: To ensure that certain implicit reads are ordered only after writes to the same memory locations, software must execute specific fence or cache-control instructions defined for this purpose (such as the FENCE.I instruction defined in Chapter 5).
grades.reason: 提供了 FENCE.I 用于约束隐式读取顺序的背景，但未说明其作用范围，不能判断本地执行是否同步其他 hart 的取指。
